metadata.name: 15.1.b Share of legally protected areas in total area
metadata.priority: Protection and improvement of the environment quality state via protection of biodiversity, including area forms of nature protection, improvement of water quality and protection of water purity
metadata.definition: Share of the total area of the country covered by forms of protection for animate and inanimate nature and landscapes aimed at conserving natural resources, features and components.
metadata.methodology: The area of legally protected sites of special natural value comprises national parks, nature reserves, landscape parks, protected landscape areas, documentation sites, ecological areas, and landscape–nature complexes.It excludes nature reserves, documentation sites, ecological areas, and landscape–nature complexes located within landscape parks and protected landscape areas to avoid double counting.It also includes the portion of the Natura 2000 network located within national parks, nature reserves, landscape parks, protected landscape areas, documentation sites, ecological areas, and landscape–nature complexes.
